mentions.name: Correctify Design Studio
mentions.description: A design studio launched within Correctify that converts long-form menu text into print-ready menu designs in minutes, and is one of the few long-form-text-to-design models available.
mentions.source_excerpt: We recently launched Design Studio which takes menu text and converts it into print-ready menu designs in minutes. Essentially, Design Studio is among the very few long-form-text-to-design models available.
